seed_policy: same five fresh init/train pairs in every architecture; never replaced; identical ids across architectures are not extra independent replicates
reference_arm_definition: the seed's own unprotected author run; protected arms fork from its locked t0 checkpoint with identical model, Adam and PRNG state

timing.smoothing: centered three-point mean, defined only when both 100k neighbours exist

path_set.ranking: exp039 discovery score: mean over protection tasks of mean(native donor CE - single-path donor CE); ties smaller path id
path_set.coverage: minimum over protection tasks of mean(native-set donor CE gain)/mean(native-full donor CE gain) on discovery inputs
path_set.selection: smallest ranked prefix reaching coverage_target; otherwise the prefix with maximum coverage, ties smaller k
path_set.random_control: same size and same per-source-layer counts, uniformly drawn from non-selected heads by a hash-seeded RNG, fixed before any protected update

mechanism_gate_role: recorded and analysed as a moderator; it never skips P/PR arms (all-applicable-seeds analysis)

checkpoint_retention.normal: every 100k checkpoint kept (fork points and A window evaluations)
checkpoint_retention.arms: multiples of 500k, the 11 window stages and the final state kept; other 100k resume states are rolling

analysis.primary_test: one-sided paired Student t over applicable training seeds within each architecture, H0 mean difference <= 0
analysis.primary_family: 3 hypotheses x 3 architectures, Holm at alpha 0.05
analysis.unit: training seed; rows are first averaged over the 11 window checkpoints
analysis.within_seed_uncertainty: true query class cluster-robust standard error
analysis.secondary: all other arm contrasts, cross-entropy, original task, marginal cost, correction size, label-K effect retention, coverage moderator; reported with intervals, not used as gates

execution.jaxlib_supported_gpus: compute capability 5.2-9.0 (Maxwell..Hopper); Blackwell sm_100/sm_120 unsupported by jaxlib 0.4.26
